title: A Crowd at {target.name}'s Door
summary: Enough people in one place refuse {target} by their own Lines that a crowd forms, for their own reasons, with no plot point behind it. Each decides for themselves whether to lead it, join it, stand in its way or face it.

hooks.situation: {target} is here, and you are not the only one who will not stand for them: {follower} feels it too, and others. A word from you and it becomes a crowd.

options.label: Gather the others and go to {target} together

effects.text: Tell {player} the people here have had enough of {target}, and ask whose side they are on.

options.label: Go to {target} alone and say it to their face

effects.text: Tell {player} you said it to {target}'s face yourself, and that you won't be the one to start a crowd.

hooks.situation: People here have turned against {target}, {ringleader} among them. You have your own reasons to stand with them, or not.

options.label: Go to {target} with whoever else will

effects.text: Tell {player} you stood with the others against {target}, and why.

options.label: Agree with them, and stay where you are

effects.text: Tell {player} what you think of {target}, but that you want no part in a crowd.

hooks.situation: People here have turned against {target}, {ringleader} among them. You have your own reasons to stand with them, or not.

options.label: Go to {target} with whoever else will

effects.text: Tell {player} you stood with the others against {target}, and why.

options.label: Agree with them, and stay where you are

effects.text: Tell {player} what you think of {target}, but that you want no part in a crowd.

hooks.situation: A crowd is gathering against {target}, led by {ringleader}. You will not see {target} harmed.

options.label: Go and stand between {target} and the crowd

effects.text: Tell {player} you stood in front of {target} when {ringleader}'s crowd came, and ask them to help keep it from turning to blood.

options.label: Get word to {target} and stay out of it

effects.text: Ask {player} to warn {target} that {ringleader} has people behind them.

hooks.situation: {ringleader} and others are turning against you here. You can feel it in how they look at you.

options.label: Stay where you are and face them

effects.text: Tell {player} that {ringleader} has turned people against you, and ask whether they are one of them.

options.label: Go home and bar the door

effects.text: Tell {player} you were run off by {ringleader}'s crowd, and that you will not forget whose faces were in it.
